_comment: REAL captures from a working custom-generators run, 2026-08-13, viewport 1709x1314.
They are here rather than synthesised on purpose: a clean synthetic page would not
carry the FOOTER (full-width) or the RIGHT-EDGE furniture (full-height), and those
two are exactly what made the cropper silently no-op twice. The negative controls in
tests/run-tests-app-capture.sh reproduce both failures out of THESE files by zeroing
one exclusion band at a time.
`box` is the expected content box under `bands`. These are PINNED VALUES, derived
from the fixtures and checked in — not recomputed by the suite from the code under
test, which would make the assertion circular.
A REAL model-benchmarking capture, 2026-08-15. 🔴 IT IS A HISTORICAL, PRE-POPULATED STATE AND
IT IS NOT THE SOURCE OF THE LIVE STORE SCREENSHOTS. Those were re-shot on 2026-08-22 from a much
fuller app (2 combinations, 4 prompts, 16/16 grid cells) and are live; this file predates that.
Do NOT read it as evidence about the app's CONTENT, and do not 'correct' the recipe's
_contentCaveat back to match it — the caveat is the current measurement, this fixture is not.
🔴 WHY IT IS RETAINED ANYWAY: for its LAYOUT, which is the thing F11 needs and the thing that
broke. At chromeTop=182 it measures cleanly, to a different app column (x=252 w=1200) than
custom-generators' (x=364 w=972) but with the SAME top edge, 194, on the same viewport — so 182
was measured right and the app is not the variable. What changed underneath it is the conditional
rewards banner above the iframe, which moves that edge to 230. The banner state is cut FROM this
file by bannershift.py and swept in gate F11. A thin grid makes a poor screenshot and a perfectly
good layout fixture.

broken_band_controls._comment: what the SAME fixtures produce when a band is wrong — the two shapes that shipped broken. Both are asserted as negative controls.

footer_zero.detected_by: full_frame (WIDTH pinned; height only 98.2%, so an AND rule would let this through)

right_zero.detected_by: full_frame (HEIGHT pinned) AND identical_boxes — all four states report the identical box
